notes: Infiltrate: right-click to shoot slime at the screen you're on! It splats where it lands (and disappears from your screen when you leave).
Swat infiltrators to earn points — check the new trophy button in the chat for your points, the shop and the leaderboard.
Shop: 5 new bullets (paint, glitter, cream pie, squid ink, snowball) for 50 points each, and artillery for 20 points that guards your screen for 10 minutes.
